definitions.short: Urim , the oracular brilliancy of the figures in the high-priest's breastplate
definitions.full: H224. Urim אֻרִים noun [masculine] plural region of light , East Isa 24:15 (so Ges MV Ew De Di RV; Lo Hi Kn Che read איים = coasts , so Cdd. ᵐ5 ; — ᵐ5 mostly omit ᵑ9 in doctrina , thinking of Urim , see Br MP 297 ). אוּרִים noun masculine Urim (plural intensive, mostly with article the Urim , and mostly joined with תֻּמִּים q. v.) הֲסִידֶךָ לְאִישׁ וְאוּרֶיךָ תֻּמֶּיךָ Deut 33:8 thy Thummim and thy Urim has the man of thy favour , i.e. the Levite tested at Massah & Meribah; וְהִתֻּמִּים הָאוּרִים were put into the הִמִּשְׁמָּט חשֶׁן of the high priest Exod 28:30 ; Lev 8:8 (P); this חשֶׁן (q. v.) was a little bag or pouch worn on breast of high, priest, to hold the Urim & Thummim ; the name ׳ח הַמִּשְׁמָּט was given because of decisions made by that which was within it; thus, Eleazar was to inquire of ׳י for Joshua הָאוּרִים בְּמִשְׁמַּט Num 27:21 (P); Saul prayed אוּרִים הָבָה opposed to תֻּמִּים הבה , 1Sam 14:41 ᵐ5 , so We Dr ( ᵑ0 omits former, and reads תָּמִים in latter); ׳י did not answer Saul בָּאוּרִים or by dreams or prophets 28:6 ; post-exilic Jews reserved difficult questions until there stood up a priest וּלְתֻמִּים לְאוּרִים Ezra 2:63 ; Neh 7:65 (here alone without article) These passages give little information; ᵐ5 δήλωσις καὶ ἀλήθεια , ᵑ9 doctrina et veritas , Symm φωτισμοὶ καὶ τελεώτητες ; Jos Ant. iii. 8 . 9 thinks of the twelve gems of face of bag as giving decision by shining; Philo Vit. Mos. iii thinks of two small images ( ׳א & ׳ת ), probably embroidered in the cloth of the bag, like oracle-images of Egypt (Diod 1, 48, 75 Aelian Var. Hist.14, 34 ); Ew Geschichte iii, 309 ; Antiq. 295, of two stones of different colours for sacred lot, on this see Dr 1Sam 14:41 where אוּרִים ᵐ5 & תֻּמִּים as object of give, δος = הָבָה ; compare הִמִּילוּ 14:42 , וַיִלָּכֵד 14:41 (used of taking by lot 10:20 ; Isa 7:14 , 16 ); see also We & RS OTJC Lect x. N 4 ; Bähr Symbolik , of one thing within bag, a sacred pledge to high priest of the enlightenment & perfection he would receive from ׳י when called to make sacred decisions; Ka Ex 544 sees the sacred pledge in the twelve sacred gems themselves, that stimulate priest to self-sacrifice & perfect sanctification.
